_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); automaker signals, the early era

pit_profile.why: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Industry sales volume, particularly in the United States, Europe, or China, could decline if there is a financial crisis, recession, or significant geopolitical event.' and 'Ford’s results are dependent on sales of larger, more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2017 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Industry sales volume, particularly in the United States, Europe, or China, could decline if there is a financial crisis, recession, or significant geopolitical event.' and 'Ford’s results are dependent on sales of larger, more profitable vehicles, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2017 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.12x; +15% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.73; conservative 2yr +14%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -28.0%/yr (worst year FY09-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-8.4%/yr (Q2 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.6-yr ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +91.1%/yr (FY09-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +1128.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: F (retrospective, 2018-08-24) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.12x (48.3% downside to Bear $5 / +406.2% upside to Bull $49) | Adj composite 1.95 vs market 1.22: gap +0.73 [UNDERVALUED] | +15% above the EPP floor $8 (6x FY18E $1.40) | Conservative 2-yr case: +14.0% total (+7.0%/yr) | At 6.9x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $13 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; wholesale units -9.6% in Q2 2018, forward revenues -2.3% (no Q3 2018 revenue guide, Q2 2018 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an automaker on this date.
